title: Detect a dependent-clause fragment
instructions: Identify the option that is a sentence fragment.

parts.prompt: Which option is incomplete because it contains only a dependent clause?

options.text: The debate ended after every team had spoken.
The judges compared their notes while the audience waited.
Although the final decision surprised several students.
The winning team thanked its coach before leaving.

choice_rationales.A: The debate ended is an independent clause; the after clause adds time information.
choice_rationales.B: The judges compared their notes is an independent clause; the while clause is attached to it.
choice_rationales.C: Although makes the clause dependent, and no independent clause completes the contrast.
choice_rationales.D: The winning team thanked its coach is a complete independent clause.

parts.hint: Find the opening word that promises a contrast, then check whether a main clause completes it.
parts.correct_explanation: “Although the final decision surprised several students” is dependent and needs a main clause to complete the contrast.
